places: National Day (birthday of Grand Duke HENRI)

fields.climate: modified continental with mild winters, cool summers
fields.terrain: mostly gently rolling uplands with broad, shallow valleys; uplands to slightly mountainous in the north; steep slope down to Moselle flood plain in the southeast
fields.resources: iron ore (no longer exploited), arable land
fields.farm: milk, wheat, barley, triticale, potatoes, pork, grapes, beef, rye, rapeseed
fields.exports: iron blocks, gas turbines, plastic products, rubber tires, plastics
fields.industries: banking and financial services, construction, real estate services, iron, metals, and steel, information technology, telecommunications, cargo transportation and logistics, chemicals, engineering…
fields.languages: Luxembourgish (official administrative, judicial, and national language) 48.9%, Portuguese 15.4%, French (official administrative, judicial, and legislative language) 14.9%, Italian 3.6%, English…
fields.religions: Christian (predominantly Roman Catholic) 70.6%, Muslim 2.3%, other (includes Buddhist, folk religions, Hindu, Jewish) 0.4%, unaffiliated 26.7%
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory

holiday.name: National Day (birthday of Grand Duke HENRI)

fields.military: 18-26 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription (abolished 1969)
